findings.description: storage_encrypted is set to false, so the RDS instance's underlying storage, snapshots and backups are stored unencrypted.
publicly_accessible = true assigns the RDS instance a public IP and DNS name, exposing the MySQL endpoint to the internet rather than keeping it in a private subnet.
The master username is the default 'admin', a predictable account name that makes credential-guessing attacks against the publicly reachable database easier.

The master password is supplied through a Terraform variable and will be persisted in plain text in the Terraform state file and any plan output instead of being sourced from Secrets Manager / managed master password.
No enabled_cloudwatch_logs_exports (audit/error/general/slowquery) are configured, so database access and security-relevant events are not retained for audit.

The EC2 user_data embeds the database endpoint, username and the master password (var.password) in plain text; user data is readable by anyone with ec2:DescribeInstanceAttribute or from the instance metadata service.

No metadata_options block enforcing http_tokens = "required", so the legacy IMDSv1 remains enabled and an SSRF in the hosted PHP application can retrieve the instance role's credentials (which have s3:*, ec2:*, rds:*).
No root_block_device/ebs encryption is specified, so the instance volume containing the plaintext dbinfo.inc credentials file may be stored unencrypted.
The instance role grants s3:*, ec2:* and rds:* on Resource "*", far exceeding least privilege; compromise of the web instance yields broad control over storage, compute and databases in the account.
The RDS security group allows all outbound traffic to 0.0.0.0/0 on all ports and protocols, providing a data exfiltration and command-and-control path.

The database security group is defined without explicit egress restrictions and is paired with an allow-all egress rule; combined with publicly_accessible on the DB it does not constrain traffic to the workload's requirements.
The MySQL parameter group does not set require_secure_transport = 1, so clients may connect to the database without TLS.
